_doc: Where an identical copy rests nested in a bowl asset: origin-to-origin height (m), measured in G3's physics-only twin by dropping one copy onto another on its axis and letting it settle (scripts/skills/h95_nest_probe.py, 2026-10-28). PhysX nests by the colliders, so this is the truth the mesh-only estimates (library.bowl_geometry 'bins', nest_profile_dz) approximate. An asset constant.
